name: autochatbot-fb-crm
description: FB Personal Messenger CRM - Desktop Application
author: Adsup <contact@adsup.vn>

scripts.build:all: npm run build:ui && npm run build:bytecode && npm run build:extension
scripts.dist: npm run build:all && node scripts/rebuild-native-for-electron.js prepare && node scripts/rebuild-native-for-electron.js verify && electron-builder && node scripts/rebuild-native-for-electron.js restore
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:all && node scripts/rebuild-native-for-electron.js prepare && node scripts/rebuild-native-for-electron.js verify && electron-builder --win && node scripts/rebuild-native-for-electron.js restore
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build:all && node scripts/rebuild-native-for-electron.js prepare && node scripts/rebuild-native-for-electron.js verify && electron-builder --linux && node scripts/rebuild-native-for-electron.js restore
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:all && node scripts/rebuild-native-for-electron.js prepare && node scripts/rebuild-native-for-electron.js verify && electron-builder --mac && node scripts/rebuild-native-for-electron.js restore
